name: B2B Agency Lead Pipeline: Tech Stack & SEO/GEO Audit -> Verified Decision-Makers (Apify)

parameters.content:
## B2B Agency Pipeline (Zero API Keys, $0 on Dead Sites)

**How it works:**
1. Scans prospect domains with **Website Tech Stack, Pixels & SEO/GEO Audit Detector** (`$15/1k`, `$0` on unreachable sites).
2. Filters ONLY prospects with real `salesOpportunities` (missing Meta Pixel, missing `/llms.txt`, blocked AI bots, expiring SSL, missing DMARC).
3. Enriches ONLY qualified domains with **Website Email, Phone & Decision-Maker Finder** (`$0` start fee, `$0` on empty sites, GDPR source URL provenance).

**Setup (30 sec):**
Set `APIFY_TOKEN` in your n8n environment variables (or replace the Authorization header with your Apify Bearer token from console.apify.com/settings/integrations).

Actors: https://apify.com/aegisaudit

parameters.content:
## Connect Your Destination
Attach **Google Sheets**, **HubSpot**, **Smartlead**, **Instantly**, or **Clay Webhook** directly after `Merge Audit + Verified Contacts (CRM Ready)`.

Each row already includes:
- `contactEmail` (MX-verified, never guessed)
- `contactName` & `contactRole`
- `sourceUrl` (GDPR Art. 14 provenance)
- `pitchSummary` (exact technical gaps found on their site)
